name: Honor
overview: Scripture calls believers to honor God and others as a reflection of a righteous life. Honoring parents is commanded by the LORD with the promise of long life and well-being in the land (Exodus 20:12; Deuteronomy 5:16). Beyond family, honoring the LORD with our resources is an expression of true devotion (Proverbs 3:9), and pursuing righteousness and mercy leads to receiving honor (Proverbs 21:21). Love, purity, and commitment to good further underpin a life marked by genuine honor (Romans 12:9).
